name: per-word-crossfade
description: Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.

vars.description: The line to animate. It is split on whitespace and every word gets its own span, so the stagger picks up the new words.
Scales the vertical offset, so the words cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.
Scales the blur radius the timeline drives, from a light haze to a full smear.
Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
